hero_kpi_rationale: TPV (Total Payment Volume) is the primary growth metric in payment fintechs, reflecting real adoption and commercial expansion in emerging markets, a key segment of dLocal's strategy.

kpis.name: Total Payment Volume Growth
kpis.explanation: Total volume of transactions processed by the platform, up 45% year-on-year.
kpis.description: TPV reached $26 billion in 2024, driven by geographic and sector diversification.
kpis.signal: Strong and accelerating growth in emerging markets.

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Revenue after deduction of direct payment processing costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin reached $295 million in 2024, reflecting the efficiency of the business model.
kpis.signal: High gross margin despite rapid growth.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA to Gross Profit Ratio
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profitability as a proportion of gross profit.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA to gross profit ratio remains high at 0.64, despite ongoing investments.
kpis.signal: Very high operating margin for a growth-stage fintech.

kpis.name: Net Take Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of transaction volume that dLocal retains as revenue.
kpis.description: Net take rate is 1.1%, impacted by emerging market currency depreciation.
kpis.signal: Slight pressure on unit margins due to currency and mix effects.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: dLocal had 1,095 employees at the end of 2024, with significant growth in tech teams.
kpis.signal: Team expansion to support technological and geographic growth.

kpis.name: Number of Merchants
kpis.explanation: Number of merchant clients using the platform.
kpis.description: Over 700 merchants served at end-2024, with a TPV retention rate above 140%.
kpis.signal: Expanding customer base with strong retention metrics.

kpis.name: TPV Retention Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of payment volume from existing merchants that renews.
kpis.description: A retention rate above 140% indicates merchants are increasing their volume on the platform.
kpis.signal: Very high merchant loyalty, indicating strong perceived value.

kpis.name: AI Features Adoption
kpis.explanation: Growing use of AI engines to improve conversion rates.
kpis.description: Launch of the Smart Request (AI) engine to dynamically optimize card authorization messages.
kpis.signal: AI embedded into key products to enhance performance.

kpis.name: Regulatory Licenses Obtained
kpis.explanation: Regulatory licenses secured to operate in new markets.
kpis.description: 9 regulatory licenses obtained in 2024, including FCA approval in the UK, strengthening compliance.
kpis.signal: Regulatory expansion critical for legitimacy and market access.

risks.title: Inability to keep pace with rapid technological evolution in the sector
risks.score_rationale: Risk stated in the executive summary (high position). Moderately intense language ("cannot keep pace"). Stable but structural trend in the payments sector. High category weight: technological innovation is critical for a payment platform.

risks.title: Intense and increasing competition in payment processing
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly listed as "substantially and increasingly intense competition". High-intensity language ("increasingly"). Upward trend. Critical category weight: global payments sector is highly competitive with established players and new entrants.

risks.title: Dependence on revenue concentration from large merchants
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned: "Certain large merchants provide a significant share of our revenues". High-intensity language ("materially harm"). Stable but structural trend. High category weight: client concentration equals major churn risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks and breaches of sensitive data
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned twice in the summary ("cyberattacks" and "breaches"). Very high-intensity language ("materially adversely affect reputation, business, and financial condition"). Upward trend (growing cyber threats). Critical category weight: payment data is a highly targeted sensitive asset.

risks.title: Absence or loss of regulatory licenses in operational jurisdictions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly listed: "may not currently hold, or be able to obtain or maintain the relevant regulatory licenses". High-intensity language ("material adverse effect"). Upward trend (payment regulation is tightening). Critical category weight: operates in 30+ countries with heterogeneous regimes.

risks.title: Tax and foreign exchange regulatory complexity in emerging markets
risks.score_rationale: Risk stated: "complex and evolving tax regimes and foreign exchange regulations". Moderately high-intensity language ("material adverse effect"). Upward trend (tax regimes tightening in Latin America). High category weight: primarily operates in Latin America with fiscal volatility.

risks.title: Dependence on reputation and risk of reputational damage
risks.score_rationale: Risk stated: "Our business depends on our reputation" and "adversely affected due to events or conditions that damage our reputation". Moderately high-intensity language. Stable trend but increased vulnerability (fintech under scrutiny). High category weight: trust is a critical asset for a payment platform.

risks.title: Geographic concentration in Latin America and politico-economic risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated: "substantial portion concentrated in Latin America". Moderately high-intensity language ("disproportionate risks"). Upward trend (growing political instability in Latin America). High category weight: region is a major revenue source with structural volatility.

ai_positioning.summary: dLocal is actively integrating artificial intelligence into its products to improve conversion rates and customer experience, without making it a central communication pillar. AI is used operationally, notably through Smart Request and cost optimization.
evidence: Launch of the Smart Request engine, an AI that dynamically adapts authorization messages to acquirers
Use of AI to reduce customer support response times by 88%
Development of an AI-based cost optimization engine for the Smart Router
